findings.issue: Frozen glossary term 'Sentry' is approved as الرقيب, with the explicit note 'الحارس reserved for Warden/Guardian' (05_glossary.csv). This row uses الحارس for Sentry, the exact collision the glossary warns against.

findings.source_en: Rejoice! For our fair maiden, the Lady of the Woods, has returned. And what does she ask of us? No more than a small tribute, a share in all we harvest.
findings.ar: افرحوا! فعذراؤنا الجميلة، سيدة الغابة، قد عادت. وماذا تطلب منّا؟ لا أكثر من جزيةٍ يسيرة، نصيبٍ من كل ما نحصد.
findings.issue: Same recurring issue flagged in chunks 78/81: generic 'tribute' rendered with الجزية (the Islamic poll tax on non-Muslims), the same wrong-institution problem the glossary explicitly flags for 'tithes' (should be العُشور-style wording, not الجزية). This is now the third/fourth occurrence of the same systemic word-choice error across the corpus.
findings.suggested_ar: لا أكثر من إتاوةٍ يسيرة، نصيبٍ من كل ما نحصد.
